title: Common definitions
description: Named formats and shared structures of all contracts (03-api.md section 1, 04-crypto.md sections 1 and 4).

uuid.description: UUIDv7, lower-case text with dashes (04-crypto.md section 1)

time.description: ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (03-api.md section 1)

credential_id.description: WebAuthn credential ID as b64u (1 to 1023 bytes)

bundle_slot.description: identity bundle slot: recovery or passkey:<canonical b64u credential ID>

workvm_id.description: ID of a work VM (13-work-vm.md section 1, KOR-29)

attention_category.description: category of a task's attention record (ADR-076, contracts/enums/attention.json)

attention_reason.description: reason code of an attention record: closed list per category in contracts/enums/attention.json; a later package adds reasons (additive), so clients show an unknown reason with its category's generic text

capacity.description: device capacity (02-data-model.md section 2.1); the optional counters and settings come from ADR-075 section 2

orgs.description: agent_batches_incomplete: the organizations whose batch is missing, not expected or does not add the agent (ADR-082 section 2)

devices.description: peer_outdated: the active devices of the org that have not announced the needed feature (ADR-060)

quota.description: the limit a context checkpoint reached (quota_exceeded, ADR-072 section 6): per checkpoint or per organisation, in sealed bytes

paging_required.description: request_invalid: the unpaged answer would exceed its cap; repeat with paging (GET /v1/platform/enrollments, ADR-086 section 2)

reason.description: orchestrator_unavailable: why the session cannot become the main orchestrator (ADR-082 section 9.6, 11-agent-access.md section 11; `analysis`: a session of an analysis task, ADR-097 section 2); forbidden with `analysis`: the profile of an analysis task is only narrowed (ADR-097 section 2)

wrap.description: key wrap as sent by its creator (04-crypto.md section 4.2)

stored_wrap.description: key wrap as stored by the hub

event_header.description: event header, exact key set (04-crypto.md section 4.3, E1)

event_header_terminal.description: event header, exact key set (04-crypto.md section 4.3, E1); kind session.terminal

event_header_other.description: event header, exact key set (04-crypto.md section 4.3, E1); every kind except session.terminal

event_header_prompt.description: event header, exact key set (04-crypto.md section 4.3, E1); kind prompt

event.description: encrypted, signed event (04-crypto.md section 4.3); terminal chunks at most 64 KiB, other kinds at most 256 KiB (E8)

ct.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext, at most 256 KiB decoded (04-crypto.md E8)
AES-256-GCM ciphertext, at most 64 KiB decoded (04-crypto.md E8)
AES-256-GCM ciphertext, at most 256 KiB decoded (04-crypto.md E8)

log_body_admit.description: body of a admit entry (ADR-060): an admin admits an existing account; identity anchors in the platform log

log_entry_body.description: membership-log entry body: common fields org, seq, prev, type, by, ts, v plus exactly the fields of its type (04-crypto.md section 4.7)

log_entry.description: membership-log entry (04-crypto.md section 4.7); inv_sig exactly on accept entries

pub.description: Ed25519 public key of the platform root

platform_body_device_certify.description: body of a device_certify entry; agent_version, os, arch and capacity are copied from the enrollment body so that enroll_sig and inv_sig can be checked over the enrollment text (contracts/changes/CRY-02.md)

platform_body_user_certify.description: body of a user_certify entry (ADR-060): the root attests the identity keys of a user

platform_body_user_decertify.description: body of a user_decertify entry (ADR-060): ends the valid certification of a user

platform_body_platform_policy.description: body of a platform_policy entry (ADR-079: a switch, the latest entry of a name counts)

platform_body_org_operator_subscriptions.description: body of a org_operator_subscriptions entry (ADR-079: the organization's members use the operator's subscriptions)

platform_entry_body.description: platform-log entry body: common fields seq, prev, type, by, ts, v plus exactly the fields of its type (04-crypto.md section 4.8)

platform_entry.description: platform-log entry, signed by the platform root (04-crypto.md section 4.8)

credential_header.description: credential record header, exact key set (04-crypto.md section 4.4)

device_request_header.description: device request header, exact key set (04-crypto.md section 4.5)

device_response_header.description: device response header, exact key set (04-crypto.md section 4.5)

device_request_envelope.description: device request, HPKE to the device (04-crypto.md section 4.5)

device_response_envelope.description: device response, HPKE to the user identity (04-crypto.md section 4.5)

bundle_ct.description: identity bundle: b64u(nonce12 || AES-GCM(KEK, plaintext)) (04-crypto.md section 4.1)

stored_event.description: event with its hub order and receive time

community_header.description: community message header, exact key set (14-community.md section 3)

ct.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the body, at most 16 KiB decoded (14-community.md section 3)

community_wrap_text.description: b64u of an HPKE wrap of the community key (enc 32 B, key 32 B, tag 16 B)

q_index.description: path parameter text: the index of a context chunk (ADR-072)

context_fallback_reason.description: why a session continued with a new conversation instead of restoring its checkpoint (ADR-072 section 7)

context_reason.description: why a main session's continuation is noteworthy (session row context_reason, ADR-072 section 7): with context_restore fallback one of the fallback reasons; with context_restore restored workspace_partial (the conversation is complete, parts of the workspace were left out) or workspace_omitted (the workspace was too large and was not restored); with context_restore restored also golden_switch (the session's VM was switched to a newer golden while it was paused and the whole workspace came along, ADR-093 section 4)

context_workspace.description: what a restore brought back of the workspace (audit session.context_restored, ADR-072 section 7): full, partial (some entries were left out and counted), omitted (too large, not part of the checkpoint) or empty (there was nothing)

context_manifest.description: manifest of a context checkpoint (04-crypto.md section 4.11, ADR-072 section 3): canonical JSON, signed by the author device

log_manifest.description: manifest of a log of a test run or work VM job (04-crypto.md section 4.12, ADR-080 section 3): canonical JSON, signed by the author device; ref = the run_id or job_id, bytes = the full output length, stored = the kept bytes

task_waiting_reason.description: reasons of a waiting (scheduling) task beyond the session failure reasons (03-api.md section 4.6.2, ADR-075 section 7; enums/task-states.json)

agent_gen.description: generation of an agent's delegation certificate (ADR-082 section 9.1)

log_agent_member.description: optional agent member of genesis and accept (ADR-082): the entry also adds the user's agent and is signed by the agent's key; cert is the user's signature over P||'agent-cert\0'||canonical({agent, gen, pub, user, v: 1})

log_body_agent_add.description: body of a agent_add entry (ADR-082): by is the user or the agent itself (subject); cert as in log_agent_member

log_body_support_grant.description: body of a support_grant entry (ADR-096): releases the workgroup to the support team with read or write; by an admin or a user with write on the workgroup

log_body_support_revoke.description: body of a support_revoke entry (ADR-096): ends the release; owes the rotation of the workgroup

browser_frame.description: live frame of a platform browser session (04-crypto.md section 4.13, ADR-085 section 6): clear except ct, no signature; seq is the frame counter of the browser session (not the action seq)

ct.description: b64u(nonce12 || AES-256-GCM(k_frame, jpeg, AAD)), 29 bytes to 512 KiB + 28 bytes decoded

vm_upgrade.description: the switch of an outdated workgroup VM to the newest golden of its device (ADR-093 section 3): the golden it moves to, state waiting (holds name who or what keeps it, since when) or switching, and the paused main sessions that move with it; IDs, reasons and times only

holds.description: at most 16 to a hub without vm_upgrade_version, at most 64 to a hub of vm_upgrade_version 2 (HOT-24)

vm_upgrade_hold.description: one cause that keeps an outdated workgroup VM on its golden (ADR-093 section 1): session_active (a session that is not paused), subagent (a child session that has not ended), checkpoint_due, checkpoint_missing, workspace_incomplete (a paused session's newest checkpoint is due, missing or left part of the workspace out), checkpoint_impossible (a paused session that worked can never be checkpointed on this VM, e.g. its guest has no export route; only a switch by hand moves the VM, ADR-093 addendum HOT-24), capacity (no free slot for the new VM), switch_failed (the last attempt failed); session_id names the session; since is when the device first saw the cause; checkpoint_at (checkpoint_impossible only) is when the checkpoint was taken that the session would continue from after a switch by hand, absent when it would start fresh

agent_profile_name.description: name of a rights profile: a built-in role or an own profile of an organization or a workgroup (ADR-094 section 2)

agent_profile_reads.description: reach of the read tools of a profile, narrowest first: task, workgroup, all (ADR-094 section 1)

agent_profile.description: a resolved rights profile (ADR-094 section 1): the operation types a session may request and the reach of its reads

agent_profile_scope.description: where a profile is defined (ADR-094 section 2)

mode_name.description: name of a working mode of the catalogue contracts/modes (ADR-098 section 1); a stable identifier

mode_way.description: how a working mode was chosen (ADR-098 section 3): web (a person in the browser), tool (a person's agent outside the platform), sentence (task.mode with a quote of the person's instruction), inherited (passed on by a session of a task that has the mode)

task_mode.description: a working mode that is on for a task (hub.task_mode, ADR-098 section 3): name, catalogue version, who chose it, how and when; metadata only

mode_driver_state.description: the state of a mode's driver as its device reports it (ADR-098 section 4): metadata only - the name of the current step, counters and the time of the next step; content travels in sealed events

device_task_mode.description: a working mode that is on for a task, as the device state carries it (KOR-75): the record and the driver state last reported (null before the first report)
